name: Santa Cruz de Moya (Spain)
description: Square red flag charged at the centre with a yellow lozenge throughout bearing four red pales, between two small yellow triangles at the hoist and fly.
history: Municipal flag of Santa Cruz de Moya; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
